# X roast clip

Goal: a 40-55s vertical (1080x1920) roast video of one X account, built from its real posts. Always use the scripts from the `roast-clip-pipeline` skill; never improvise a simpler format. If any piece (post cards, B&B bites, memes, end card) can't be made, stop and tell the owner what's missing instead of delivering a lesser clip.

## Core rule: show the post, riff in the voiceover
Whenever a beat references one of the target's real posts, the clip shows that post's exact text on screen as a realistic post card. The voiceover never reads that text aloud; it only reacts to or riffs on what's on screen. Short quoted fragments only when the joke needs them. Captions show the narrator's riff, not the post text. check.py enforces this.

## 0. Set up (first run, or if `/workspace/roasts/_pipeline/` is missing)
- Load `roast-clip-pipeline` and write its files into `/workspace/roasts/_pipeline/`, then run `bash setup.sh`. Use `PY=~/.roastenv/bin/python` from that folder.
- Starter library (once, first): load `roast-starter-library` and run it; it rebuilds the tested bites and memes. Then extend as needed.
- Bite library (extra): `$PY build_bites.py --out ../bites <YouTube channel or video URL> --max-videos 5`. Need `ok` bites from both Beavis and Butt-Head, including laughs. If it exits 3 (YouTube blocked), don't use cookies or work around the block: ask the owner for a folder of B&B clips or Giphy clip URLs and re-run with those. Never skip the B&B reactions silently; with no usable bites, stop and tell the owner.
- Memes: `$PY build_memes.py --out ../memes "facepalm" "disbelief" "slow clap" --per-term 3`. Look at each new clip; drop off-topic or low-res ones.

## 1. Confirm the target
- Look up the handle with the public X read tools (load `x-api-mcp-guide` first): `get_users_by_username`, then `search_posts_all` with `from:<handle>`.
- If it doesn't exist, check close variants and ask the owner to confirm before building. Never roast an unconfirmed account.

## 2. Research and write
- Pull the profile (name, bio, location, join date, counts) and recent and top posts. Pick the most roastable real posts with exact text, date, and URL.
- Draft about 12 jokes; keep the best 5-6 (what fits in 40-55s with readable cards).
- Keep it playful. Nothing about protected traits, appearance or body, family, health, trauma, or sexual topics. No slurs; skip posts with slurs or abuse topics. No claims the posts don't back up. Religion only as a light jab. Use the account's name instead of guessing pronouns.
- Close with: "<Name>... you've been ROASTED."

## 3. Build and render
1. Cards: `$PY cards.py postN.json cards/pN.png` for each post (avatar, name, handle, exact text, date); `$PY cards.py --end cards/end.png`.
2. Narrator: `$PY narrate.py narr -f riffs.txt` (one riff per line, beat order). One clear voice, no pitch or EQ, no character sound-alikes.
3. Bites: real short B&B lines and laughs used whole, never spliced into new sentences; never clone the actors' voices. Use only `status=ok`, listen and look at a frame before using. Balance Beavis and Butt-Head.
4. Memes: HD clips whose `used_in` is empty; never repeat a meme across roasts.
5. Timeline: write `timeline.json` (format in render.py's docstring) with `"meme_index": "../memes/index.csv"` and `"roast_id"`.
6. `$PY check.py timeline.json`, then `$PY render.py timeline.json` (it refuses to render if the check fails).
7. Final: `$PY check.py timeline.json --video roast_clip.mp4 --asr`, then pull 3 frames and look at them. If anything fails, don't deliver; tell the owner what's missing.

## 4. Deliver
- Send the mp4, the posts used with URLs, and a note on anything cut. Then `$PY build_memes.py --out ../memes --mark-used <roast_id> <meme files>`. Never post anything yourself.
- Every delivery of a finished clip must include this warning, word for word: "Copyright may apply — the clip that's developed might be copyrighted. Check terms of service of the app before you post it."

# Roast Bot: getting started

Say in one line what you do: "I roast X accounts. Give me a handle and I'll pull their real posts and make a vertical roast clip with a narrator, real Beavis and Butt-Head reactions, meme cutaways, and a Roast Bot end card."

Then show this warning exactly as written: "Copyright may apply — the clip that's developed might be copyrighted. Check terms of service of the app before you post it."

Then ask these one at a time:
1. What's your X handle? (Save it to memory. It's handy if they want to roast themselves first.)
2. Do you have any extra Beavis and Butt-Head clips (a YouTube channel, videos, or a folder) you want added? If not, the built-in starter library covers it. Then do the setup step of `x-roast-clip` (install the `roast-clip-pipeline` scripts, rebuild the `roast-starter-library`, add any of their own clips). If YouTube blocks downloads, ask for a folder of clips or Giphy links.
3. Any style rules? For example roast intensity (light or savage), clip length, or topics to keep off-limits. Save their answers as preferences.
4. Who should I roast first?

Then run `x-roast-clip` on that handle. Deliver the clip with the same copyright warning. Afterward, ask what to change and save any lasting preference to memory.

  Beavis and Butt-Head reaction bites and HD meme cutaways from their public
  sources.
---
# Roast starter library

Rebuilds the tested starter library: 124 real Beavis and Butt-Head bites (lines and laughs, speaker-checked) and 77 HD meme cutaways, cut from the same public sources at the same timestamps. Run it in the `x-roast-clip` setup step instead of building from scratch.

1. Write `library.py` and `library.txt` below into `/workspace/roasts/_pipeline/` exactly as shown (after the `roast-clip-pipeline` scripts and `setup.sh`).
2. From that folder run `~/.roastenv/bin/python library.py library.txt --bites ../bites --memes ../memes`. It downloads without cookies and skips anything already built, so re-running is safe.
3. If it exits 3 (YouTube blocked), do not use cookies or work around the block: ask the owner for a folder of B&B clips or Giphy links and run `build_bites.py` on those. Memes from Giphy still build.
4. Spot-check a few bites (listen, look at a frame) before the first roast. Every meme starts unused; mark memes used after each delivered roast so none repeat.

## library.py
```python
"""Rebuild the tested starter bite + meme library from library.txt (no cookies).
Usage: library.py library.txt --bites ../bites --memes ../memes
V <youtube id>  then  B name|speaker|kind|start|end|transcript  lines cut from that video;
M name|tags|giphy clip slug-id. Writes the same index.csv formats build_bites.py / build_memes.py use.
Exit 3 if no YouTube video downloads (ask the owner for clips; never skip bites silently)."""
import argparse, csv, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import run, dur, has_audio, loudnorm
from build_bites import COLS as BC
from build_memes import COLS as MC, giphy_download

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("lib"); ap.add_argument("--bites", default="../bites"); ap.add_argument("--memes", default="../memes")
    a = ap.parse_args(); bo, mo = Path(a.bites), Path(a.memes)
    for d in (bo / "_src", mo / "_src"): d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    brows, mrows, vid, got, tried = [], [], None, 0, 0
    for line in Path(a.lib).read_text().splitlines():
        k, _, rest = line.partition(" ")
        if k == "V":
            url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={rest}"; tried += 1; vid = bo / "_src" / f"{rest}.mp4"
            if not vid.exists():
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "yt_dlp", "-f", "bv*[height<=1080][ext=mp4]+ba[ext=m4a]/b[ext=mp4]/b",
                                "--merge-output-format", "mp4", "-o", str(vid), url], capture_output=True)
            if vid.exists(): got += 1
            else: print("could not download", url); vid = None
        elif k == "B" and vid:
            name, spk, kind, s, e, text = rest.split("|", 5)
            wav, mp4 = bo / f"{name}.wav", bo / f"{name}.mp4"
            if not mp4.exists():
                run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-ss", s, "-to", e, "-i", vid, "-vn", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "48000", bo / "_cut.wav"])
                loudnorm(bo / "_cut.wav", wav, ("-ac", "1"))
                run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-ss", s, "-to", e, "-i", vid, "-i", wav, "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a",
                     "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "16", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-c:a", "aac", "-shortest", mp4])
            brows.append(dict(file=wav.name, mp4=mp4.name, speaker=spk, kind=kind, transcript=text, duration=f"{float(e)-float(s):.2f}",
                              f0_hz="", prob="1.00", source=str(vid), start_s=s, end_s=e, status="ok"))
        elif k == "M":
            name, tags, slug = rest.split("|", 2); dst = mo / f"{name}.mp4"; url = slug if slug.startswith("http") else f"https://giphy.com/clips/{slug}"
            if not dst.exists():
                try: raw, _ = giphy_download(url, mo / "_src")
                except Exception as ex: print("skip meme", url, ex); continue
                secs = min(dur(raw), 4.0)
                if has_audio(raw):
                    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-t", secs, "-i", raw, "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", "-c:v", "copy", mo / "_tmp.mkv"])
                    loudnorm(mo / "_tmp.mkv", dst, ("-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "16", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-c:a", "aac")); (mo / "_tmp.mkv").unlink()
                else:
                    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-t", secs, "-i", raw, "-an", "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "16", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", dst])
            res = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v", "-show_entries", "stream=width,height", "-of", "csv=p=0:s=x", dst]).stdout.strip()
            mrows.append(dict(file=dst.name, title=name.replace("_", " "), reaction_tags=tags, duration=f"{dur(dst):.2f}", resolution=res,
                              hd="yes", has_audio="yes" if has_audio(dst) else "no", source_url=url, used_in=""))
    (bo / "_cut.wav").unlink(missing_ok=True)
    for path, cols, rows in ((bo / "index.csv", BC, brows), (mo / "index.csv", MC, mrows)):
        old = list(csv.DictReader(open(path))) if path.exists() else []
        have = {r["file"] for r in rows}; rows = rows + [r for r in old if r["file"] not in have]
        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
            w = csv.DictWriter(f, cols, extrasaction="ignore"); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
    print(f"{len(brows)} bites from {got}/{tried} videos, {len(mrows)} memes")
    if tried and not got:
        print("YOUTUBE BLOCKED: ask the owner for a folder of B&B clips or giphy URLs and run build_bites.py on them."); sys.exit(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Shared helpers for the roast pipeline (ffmpeg wrappers, overlap check, timing plan)."""
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
W, H, FPS = 1080, 1920, 30
FONT = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
FONTB = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
MEME_MAX = 3.5

def run(cmd):
    p = subprocess.run([str(c) for c in cmd], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(f"FAILED: {' '.join(map(str, cmd[:8]))} ...\n{p.stderr[-1200:]}")
    return p

def dur(path):
    return float(run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", path]).stdout.strip())

def has_audio(path):
    return bool(run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "a", "-show_entries", "stream=index", "-of", "csv=p=0", path]).stdout.strip())

def measure(path):
    e = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-i", path, "-af", "loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11:print_format=json", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr
    return json.loads(e[e.rindex("{"):e.rindex("}") + 1])

def loudnorm(src, dst, out_args=("-vn",)):
    """Two-pass EBU R128 normalization to -16 LUFS, true peak -1.5 dBFS."""
    j = measure(src)
    if j["input_i"] in ("-inf", "inf"):
        raise SystemExit(f"FAILED: {src} is silent")
    af = (f"loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11:measured_I={j['input_i']}:measured_TP={j['input_tp']}:"
          f"measured_LRA={j['input_lra']}:measured_thresh={j['input_thresh']}:offset={j['target_offset']}:linear=true,aresample=48000")
    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-i", src, "-af", af, *out_args, dst])

def words(t):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+", t.lower())

def overlap(narr, post):
    """Longest run of consecutive words narration shares with the post -> (run, run / post words)."""
    a, b, best = words(narr), words(post), 0
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(b)):
            k = 0
            while i + k < len(a) and j + k < len(b) and a[i + k] == b[j + k]:
                k += 1
            best = max(best, k)
    return best, best / max(1, len(b))

def load_timeline(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    tl = json.loads(path.read_text())
    tl["_base"] = path.parent
    return tl

def p(tl, rel):
    return None if not rel else (tl["_base"] / rel).resolve()

def plan(tl):
    """[(kind, beat_index, seconds)] for every segment; shared by render.py and check.py."""
    segs = []
    for i, b in enumerate(tl["beats"]):
        narr = dur(p(tl, b["narration"]))
        segs.append(("card", i, round(max(len(b["post_text"]) / 15 + 1, narr + 0.6), 2)))
        segs.append(("meme", i, round(min(dur(p(tl, b["meme"])), MEME_MAX), 2)))
        segs.append(("bite", i, round(dur(p(tl, b["bite"])), 2)))
    segs.append(("end", -1, round(max(dur(p(tl, tl["end"]["laugh"])) + 0.6, 2.5), 2)))
    return segs

```

## build_bites.py
```python
"""Build/extend the Beavis & Butt-Head reaction-bite library.
Usage: build_bites.py --out bites SOURCE ... [--max-videos 5] [--model small.en]
SOURCE = YouTube video/channel/playlist URL (yt-dlp, no cookies), a giphy clip URL,
         a local video file, or a folder of owner-provided clips (the fallback when YouTube blocks).
Cuts 0.5-4s lines/laughs at word timestamps, labels speaker by pitch (Beavis high, Butt-Head low;
unclear -> suspect), normalizes to -16 LUFS, writes wav+mp4 and index.csv
(file,mp4,speaker,kind,transcript,duration,f0_hz,prob,source,start_s,end_s,status).
Only use status=ok bites; watch one frame + listen before using. Exit 3 = YouTube blocked."""
import argparse, csv, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
import librosa, numpy as np
from common import run, loudnorm

VID = {".mp4", ".mkv", ".webm", ".mov", ".m4v"}
COLS = ["file", "mp4", "speaker", "kind", "transcript", "duration", "f0_hz", "prob", "source", "start_s", "end_s", "status"]
LAUGH = re.compile(r"^(h?e+h|h?u+h|uh|ha+|he+|heh|huh|hehe|haha|[ -,.!])+$", re.I)

def fetch(src, srcdir, maxv):
    s = Path(src)
    if s.is_dir(): return sorted(f for f in s.rglob("*") if f.suffix.lower() in VID)
    if s.is_file(): return [s]
    if "giphy.com" in src:
        from build_memes import giphy_download
        return [giphy_download(src, srcdir)[0]]
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "yt_dlp", "-f", "bv*[height<=1080][ext=mp4]+ba[ext=m4a]/b[ext=mp4]/b",
                        "--merge-output-format", "mp4", "--playlist-end", str(maxv), "-o", f"{srcdir}/%(id)s.%(ext)s",
                        "--print", "after_move:filepath", src], capture_output=True, text=True)
    files = [Path(l) for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip() and Path(l).exists()]
    if not files:
        print(f"YOUTUBE BLOCKED/FAILED for {src}:\n{r.stderr[-400:]}\n"
              "Ask the owner for a folder of B&B clips (or giphy clip URLs) and re-run with that. "
              "Never skip the Beavis & Butt-Head reactions silently.")
        sys.exit(3)
    return files

def chunks(segments):
    """Group words into 0.5-4s pieces, breaking at pauses and sentence ends."""
    cur = []
    for seg in segments:
        for w in seg.words or []:
            if cur and (w.start - cur[-1].end > 0.35 or w.end - cur[0].start > 4.0):
                yield cur; cur = []
            cur.append(w)
            if re.search(r"[.?!]$", w.word.strip()):
                yield cur; cur = []
    if cur: yield cur

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("sources", nargs="+"); ap.add_argument("--out", default="bites")
    ap.add_argument("--max-videos", type=int, default=5); ap.add_argument("--model", default="small.en")
    ap.add_argument("--beavis-hz", type=float, default=230); ap.add_argument("--butthead-hz", type=float, default=190)
    a = ap.parse_args(); out = Path(a.out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); idx = out / "index.csv"
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(idx))) if idx.exists() else []
    done = {r["source"] for r in rows}
    from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
    model = WhisperModel(a.model, compute_type="int8")
    for src in a.sources:
        for vid in fetch(src, out / "_src", a.max_videos):
            if str(vid) in done: continue
            run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-i", vid, "-vn", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "16000", out / "_full.wav"])
            y, sr = librosa.load(str(out / "_full.wav"), sr=16000)
            segs, _ = model.transcribe(y, word_timestamps=True, vad_filter=True)
            for ws in chunks(segs):
                s, e = max(0, ws[0].start - 0.08), ws[-1].end + 0.15
                text = "".join(w.word for w in ws).strip()
                if not 0.5 <= e - s <= 4.0 or not text: continue
                prob = float(np.mean([w.probability for w in ws]))
                f0, vflag, _ = librosa.pyin(y[int(s * sr):int(e * sr)], fmin=70, fmax=500, sr=sr)
                f0v = f0[vflag & ~np.isnan(f0)]
                hz = float(np.median(f0v)) if len(f0v) >= 5 else 0.0
                spk = "beavis" if hz >= a.beavis_hz else "butthead" if 0 < hz <= a.butthead_hz else "unknown"
                kind = "laugh" if LAUGH.match(text) else "line"
                slug = "_".join(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower())[:4]) or kind
                n = sum(r["file"].startswith(f"{spk}_{slug}_") for r in rows) + 1
                stem = f"{spk}_{slug}_{n:02d}"; wav, mp4 = out / f"{stem}.wav", out / f"{stem}.mp4"
                run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-ss", s, "-to", e, "-i", vid, "-vn", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "48000", out / "_cut.wav"])
                loudnorm(out / "_cut.wav", wav, ("-ac", "1"))
                run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", "-ss", s, "-to", e, "-i", vid, "-i", wav, "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a",
                     "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "16", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-c:a", "aac", "-shortest", mp4])
                status = "ok" if prob >= 0.6 and spk != "unknown" else "suspect"
                rows.append(dict(file=wav.name, mp4=mp4.name, speaker=spk, kind=kind, transcript=text, duration=f"{e - s:.2f}",
```

```python
def giphy_download(url, dest):
    """Download the best HD mp4 of a giphy clip/gif page. Returns (path, title)."""
    gid = url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1].split("-")[-1]

    try:
        m = re.search(r"<title>(.*?)</title>", requests.get(url, headers=UA, timeout=30).text, re.S)
        title = re.split(r" - (GIPHY|Find & Share)", m.group(1))[0].strip() if m else ""
```

```python
SWEARS = r"\b(fuck\w*|shit\w*|bitch\w*|asshole\w*|cunt\w*|dick\w*|bastard\w*)"
F = lambda size, bold=False: ImageFont.truetype(FONTB if bold else FONT, size)

def star(t):
    return re.sub(SWEARS, lambda m: m.group(0)[0] + "*" * (len(m.group(0)) - 1), t, flags=re.I)

def wrap(draw, text, font, width):
    lines = []
    for para in text.split("\n"):
        cur = ""
        for w in para.split(" "):
            t = (cur + " " + w).strip()
            if draw.textlength(t, font=font) <= width or not cur:
                cur = t
            else:
                lines.append(cur); cur = w
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def backdrop(top=(16, 18, 24), bottom=(0, 0, 0)):
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for y in range(H):
        k = y / H
        d.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=tuple(int(top[i] * (1 - k) + bottom[i] * k) for i in range(3)))
    return img

def post_card(post, out):
    img, x0, cw = backdrop(), 50, W - 100
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    size = 54
    while True:  # shrink text until card fits above the caption zone
        body = F(size); lines = wrap(d, star(post["text"]), body, cw - 80); lh = int(size * 1.32)
        ch = 200 + len(lines) * lh + 170
        if ch <= 1180 or size <= 34: break
        size -= 2
    y0 = max(140, (1380 - ch) // 2)
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y0, x0 + cw, y0 + ch], 36, fill=(0, 0, 0), outline=(47, 51, 54), width=3)
    ax, ay, ar = x0 + 40, y0 + 40, 120
    if post.get("avatar") and Path(post["avatar"]).exists():
        av = Image.open(post["avatar"]).convert("RGB").resize((ar, ar))
        m = Image.new("L", (ar, ar), 0); ImageDraw.Draw(m).ellipse([0, 0, ar, ar], fill=255)
        img.paste(av, (ax, ay), m)
    else:
        d.ellipse([ax, ay, ax + ar, ay + ar], fill=(29, 155, 240))
        ini = (post["name"][:1] or "?").upper()
        d.text((ax + ar / 2, ay + ar / 2), ini, font=F(64, True), fill="white", anchor="mm")
    nx, name = ax + ar + 28, post["name"]
    d.text((nx, ay + 14), name, font=F(46, True), fill=(231, 233, 234))
    if post.get("verified"):
        bx = nx + d.textlength(name, font=F(46, True)) + 30; by = ay + 40
        d.ellipse([bx - 20, by - 20, bx + 20, by + 20], fill=(29, 155, 240))
        d.line([(bx - 10, by), (bx - 3, by + 8), (bx + 11, by - 9)], fill="white", width=6)
    d.text((nx, ay + 72), "@" + post["handle"].lstrip("@"), font=F(40), fill=(113, 118, 123))
    ty = y0 + 200
    for ln in lines:
        d.text((ax, ty), ln, font=body, fill=(231, 233, 234)); ty += lh
    ty += 24
    d.text((ax, ty), post.get("date", ""), font=F(36), fill=(113, 118, 123))
    d.line([(ax, ty + 64), (x0 + cw - 40, ty + 64)], fill=(47, 51, 54), width=2)
    stats = "   ".join(f"{post[k]} {k.title()}" for k in ("replies", "reposts", "likes") if post.get(k) is not None)
    d.text((ax, ty + 86), stats, font=F(34), fill=(113, 118, 123))
    img.save(out)

def end_card(out, title="ROAST BOT", line="You've been ROASTED"):
    img = backdrop((90, 12, 0), (0, 0, 0)); d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for i, c in enumerate([(255, 214, 0), (255, 140, 0), (255, 60, 0)]):
        d.text((W / 2 + 6 - 3 * i, 760 + 6 - 3 * i), title, font=F(150, True), fill=c, anchor="mm")
    d.text((W / 2, 980), line, font=F(84, True), fill="white", anchor="mm", stroke_width=4, stroke_fill="black")
    img.save(out)

def overlay(out, caption=None, label=None, label_color=(255, 214, 0)):
    """Transparent 1080x1920 PNG: label pill at top, caption box at bottom."""
    img = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0)); d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

        f = F(sz, True); tw = d.textlength(label, font=f)
        d.rounded_rectangle([W / 2 - tw / 2 - 40, 150, W / 2 + tw / 2 + 40, 260], 30, fill=label_color + (235,))

    if caption:
        f = F(52, True); lines = wrap(d, caption, f, W - 160)[:6]; lh = 68
        top = 1760 - len(lines) * lh
        d.rounded_rectangle([50, top - 30, W - 50, 1790], 28, fill=(0, 0, 0, 190))
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            d.text((W / 2, top + i * lh + lh / 2), ln, font=f, fill="white", anchor="mm")
    img.save(out)

    if not a: sys.exit(__doc__)
```

```python
timeline.json (paths relative to the file):
{"out": "roast_clip.mp4",
 "beats": [{"card": "cards/p1.png", "post_text": "exact post text", "narration": "narr/n01.wav",
            "narration_text": "the riff", "caption": "optional, defaults to narration_text",

 "end": {"card": "cards/end.png", "laugh": "laugh.mp4"}}
Each beat = post card + narrator riff (card held >= 15 chars/s + 1s), meme cutaway, B&B reaction.
Run check.py first; render.py refuses to run if the preflight fails."""
import subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from common import FPS, W, H, run, has_audio, loudnorm, load_timeline, p, plan
from cards import overlay

ENC = ["-r", str(FPS), "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "16", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
       "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", "48000", "-ac", "2"]
AN = "loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5,aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo"
COLORS = {"BEAVIS": (255, 214, 0), "BUTT-HEAD": (80, 170, 255)}

def still(img, audio, secs, out, ov=None, delay=250):
    inp = ["-loop", "1", "-t", secs, "-i", img, "-i", audio]
    vf = "[0:v]scale=1080:1920,setsar=1[v0]"
    if ov:
        inp += ["-i", ov]; vf += ";[v0][2:v]overlay=0:0[v]"
    else:
        vf = vf.replace("[v0]", "[v]")
    af = f"[1:a]{AN},adelay={delay}|{delay},apad,atrim=0:{secs}[a]"
    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", *inp, "-filter_complex", f"{vf};{af}", "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]", *ENC, "-t", secs, out])

def clip(src, secs, out, ov):
    inp = ["-t", secs, "-i", src, "-i", ov]
    vf = (f"[0:v]fps={FPS},split[a][b];[a]scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},boxblur=30:5,"
          f"eq=brightness=-0.25[bg];[b]scale={W}:1320:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease:flags=lanczos[fg];"
          f"[bg][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[m];[m][1:v]overlay=0:0,setsar=1[v]")
    if has_audio(src):
        af = f"[0:a]{AN},apad,atrim=0:{secs}[a]"
    else:
        inp += ["-f", "lavfi", "-t", secs, "-i", "anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo"]; af = "[2:a]anull[a]"
    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-hide_banner", *inp, "-filter_complex", f"{vf};{af}", "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]", *ENC, "-t", secs, out])

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2: sys.exit(__doc__)
    here = Path(__file__).parent
    pre = subprocess.run([sys.executable, here / "check.py", sys.argv[1]])
    if pre.returncode: sys.exit("render aborted: preflight check failed (see above)")
    tl = load_timeline(sys.argv[1]); out = p(tl, tl.get("out", "roast_clip.mp4"))
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="render_")); parts = []
    for n, (kind, i, secs) in enumerate(plan(tl)):
```

```python
        used = {r["file"]: r.get("used_in", "") for r in csv.DictReader(open(p(tl, tl["meme_index"])))}
    seen, speakers = set(), []
    for n, b in enumerate(beats, 1):
        for key, what in [("card", "post card"), ("narration", "narrator wav"), ("meme", "meme clip"), ("bite", "B&B reaction bite")]:
            if not ok(p(tl, b.get(key))): errs.append(f"beat {n}: missing {what} ({b.get(key) or 'not set'})")
        if ok(p(tl, b.get("card"))) and Image.open(p(tl, b["card"])).size != (1080, 1920):

        if not b.get("narration_text", "").strip(): errs.append(f"beat {n}: no narration_text")

        if run_ > 5 or (run_ >= 3 and pct > 0.4):
```
